name: Ulf's camp by the river
notes: Training level B5 (D-59): a charcoal burner's camp beside a river. Fields as in data/maps/village.json.

art.ground: a woodland clearing beside a river: trampled grass, patches of black charcoal dust, wood chips and a few ferns

pieces.Clamp: a charcoal burner's clamp: a low dome of earth and turf with thin wisps of smoke rising from it
pieces.Hut: a small hut of bent branches, bark and turf with a low dark doorway facing down
pieces.FirePit: a ring of blackened stones for a campfire, with cold grey ash inside
pieces.Woodpile: a neat stack of split logs
pieces.Stump: a broad tree stump used as a chopping block, with an axe bitten into it
pieces.River: a clear, shallow river flowing over brown pebbles, with reeds along its left bank

alder.name: alder tree
alder.description: A riverside alder with dark, ridged bark and round leaves.
